title: Reduced collagen degradation in pelvic urine precedes kidney fibrosis induced by unilateral ureteral obstruction
comparison_or_design: Compare renal-pelvis and bladder urine preparations collected on day 3 after unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO), using the individual-urine CE-MS profiling experiment. Preserve all source-distinguishable sample names and their native CE-MS Analysis IDs.
observations_or_assays: Individual-urine capillary electrophoresis–mass spectrometry (CE-MS) peptidome profiling, excluding the separate peptide-sequence identification workflow.
excluded: Sham-operated samples, day-7 collections and other surgical/time branches.

The separate Orbitrap Fusion CE-MS/MS peptide-sequence identification experiment, its RAW/MSF acquisitions, and PXD064569 acquisition mapping. The PRIDE archive is background evidence for this excluded branch, not the source of the target CE-MS sample-to-assay mapping.
Kidney histology/fibrosis assays, peptide abundance values, statistical comparisons, correlations and peptide-sequence results.
population_or_material: Individual urine preparations labelled as UUO pelvis or UUO bladder at day 3 in Supplementary Table S1, worksheet "Peptide relative abundances".
requested_items: UUO procedure, urine compartment and post-surgery collection day. Describe the surgery/model and compartment in biological_model, biological_source or sample_material; record the numerical post-UUO collection interval in the condition table.
